description: This file is a plugin for the Trumbowyg WYSIWYG editor that adds image resizing functionality using a canvas overlay. It defines a ResizeWithCanvas class to handle canvas creation, image manipulation, and user interactions for resizing images within the editor.

classes.name: ResizeWithCanvas
classes.description: A class that manages a canvas overlay for resizing images within the editor, handling drawing, user interactions, and resetting images.

methods.description: Prevents default event behavior and stops propagation.

methods.name: ResizeWithCanvas
methods.description: Constructor for the ResizeWithCanvas class, initializing canvas and image resize logic.
